notes: 2026 brackets and rates are from 68 O.S. § 2355(D) as amended by HB 2764 (2025): 0% / 2.5% / 3.5% / 4.5%; heads of household use the married-filing-jointly schedule.
HB 2764 allows further 0.25-point rate cuts when the State Board of Equalization certifies revenue growth; the earliest possible cut takes effect January 1, 2027, so 2026 rates are unaffected.

Standard deduction ($6,350 / $12,700 / $9,350) and $1,000 personal exemption are fixed in statute (not indexed); dollar figures were confirmed in the 2025 Form 511 instructions because 2026 forms are not yet published.
Oklahoma itemized deductions are capped at $17,000 (excluding charitable and medical) and require federal itemizing; not modeled.
Dependent exemptions, additional exemptions for age 65+/blind, the Oklahoma child tax credit, EITC, sales tax relief credit and other credits are not modeled.

seDeduction.note: Oklahoma starts from federal AGI, so the deductible half of SE tax flows through with no add-back.

seHealthInsurance.note: The federal self-employed health insurance deduction is included in federal AGI and is not added back.

retirementContributions.note: SEP-IRA and solo 401(k) contributions deducted for federal AGI carry through to Oklahoma.

qbi.note: The QBI deduction is taken below federal AGI, so it does not reduce Oklahoma income.

localIncomeTax.note: Oklahoma cities and counties do not levy a local income tax.

estimatedTax.threshold: Required if you expect Oklahoma tax to exceed withholding by $500 or more.
estimatedTax.safeHarbor: No underpayment interest if timely withholding and estimated payments total at least 70% of the 2026 tax liability or 100% of the 2025 tax liability. Farmers (at least two-thirds of gross income from farming) are exempt.
estimatedTax.form: Form OW-8-ES (or pay online through OkTAP)

businessCosts.llcFormationFee: $100 Articles of Organization (Oklahoma Secretary of State, 18 O.S. § 2055).
businessCosts.annualReportFee: $25 annual certificate, due every year on the anniversary of formation (18 O.S. § 2055.2).
businessCosts.franchiseOrMinimumTax: None. Oklahoma's franchise tax was repealed starting with tax year 2024 (HB 1039X, 2023), and LLCs were not subject to it before.
